summary: The FFLA index lists Karnack (Loc 1) in Harrison County as a gone tower. No source found describes it. Loc 2 is a separate standing site.

facts.status_note: FFLA lists it as gone. No source gives a removal date or describes the site today.

evidence.supports: Listed as a tower in Harrison County with status Gone
A second, separate Karnack tower site, listed as standing

notes_for_editor: No story written. The only source is the FFLA index. Two web searches and reads of the Texas Escapes Karnack town history found no lookout at Karnack. That page covers the town and Lady Bird Johnson's childhood home. Keep Loc 1 separate from Loc 2, which has its own research file at data/research/us-tx-karnack-loc-2.json. The Loc 1 point is about 7 km north of Loc 2. Caddo Lake State Park was suggested as a nearby landmark by a search summary, unverified and not used. Leads: the Cavallerano book Fire in the Piney Woods, the Texas A&M Forest Service archive (403 to fetch), and the Harrison County Historical Museum.
